{{Quote|It's nice to know that for every failure, there's a success like you.|Unidentified Amnesty Affairs commissioner, to Elia Kane|<ref name="Chapter 19" />}}
A '''Twi'lek''' individual served as the [[Amnesty Affairs Commissioner]] within the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Amnesty Program|Amnesty Program]], a rehabilitation program for former members of the [[Galactic Empire]] who passed through the [[Re-Integration Institute]]. The [[Twi'lek]] had a [[Color|blue]] uniform with a [[Rebel command insignia|command insignia]] denoting a [[military rank]] of [[captain]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Amnesty Affairs Commissioner debuted in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the third episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]]. The Amnesty Affairs Commissioner was played by [[Sunkrish Bala]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />
